digest.component_or_area: RP-02 through RP-06 derisk investigation and approval
propositions: Five approved recovered proposal (RP) decisions on BindingStore transactions, Jira lifecycle handling, configuration composition, CLI routing, and review-gate policy require evidence-backed derisk briefs before implementation stories to preserve architectural intent and resolve ambiguities.

Each RP independently researched against current source, focused tests, historical tickets/ADRs, and prior art; decision-ready briefs document situation, intended end state, invariants, failure scenarios, implementation seams, migration hazards, and maintainer-only remaining choices.

Approved decisions consolidate atomicity semantics (RP-02), scoped retry envelopes and finite-pass fuses (RP-03), operation-snapshot composition (RP-04), lazy command-registry routing with normalized help (RP-05), and effective-policy discovery with typed failure recovery (RP-06).
No tracked repository files or production code changed during investigation; all durable outputs and maintainer decisions recorded as checkout-local ignored artifacts and ticket comments.

Cross-RP dependencies establish concrete execution order and implementation boundaries: RP-03 depends on RP-02; RP-04 supplies resolved operation authority to RP-01/RP-03/RP-05; RP-01 owns runtime retry beneath RP-06 while allowing stable cutover without hard tracker dependency.
